messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none. Duplicates must refer to exactly the same real-world thing: different drugs, brand names, ingredients, formulations, doses, or a general category versus one of its members are NOT duplicates.

item: "avoid medication errors by using prescribed medicine"
set: ["avoid medication errors by using prescribed medicine", "avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes", "keep using all other medications as prescribed by your doctor", "avoid using kitchen spoon", "take as prescribed by your doctor", "only use as prescribed by your physician", "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor", "keep using the medication as directed", "ask doctor before using opioid medication", "dose prescribed by your doctor may be used", "take exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider", "take prescribed dose as indicated by healthcare provider", "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor", "tell doctor about drugs prescribed by other doctors", "take extra vitamin B12 as prescribed by doctor", "symptoms may occur with or without using medication"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
JSON:

completion:
{
  "duplicates": [
    "avoid medication errors by using only the medicine your doctor prescribes",
    "take as prescribed by your doctor",
    "only use as prescribed by your physician",
    "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor",
    "keep using the medication as directed",
    "take exactly as prescribed by your healthcare provider",
    "take prescribed dose as indicated by healthcare provider",
    "take only the amount prescribed by your doctor",
    "take extra vitamin B12 as prescribed by doctor"
  ],
  "alias": "use exactly as prescribed by your doctor"
}
